name: gizza-ai/markdown-to-pdf
summary: Convert a Markdown document into a formatted PDF.

tool.description: Convert a Markdown document into a clean, formatted, paginated PDF (US Letter). Renders headings, bold/italic, ordered and unordered (nested) lists, fenced and inline code (monospace), block quotes, tables, horizontal rules, and task lists. Content flows across as many pages as needed using the built-in Helvetica and Courier fonts. font_size (base body size in points, default 11), margin (points, default 72 = 1 inch), page_size (letter or a4), and optional page_numbers are configurable. Returns a PDF. Runs locally — the document never leaves the device.

markdown.description: The Markdown document to convert into a PDF.

font_size.description: Base body font size in points (default 11). Headings are scaled up from this.

margin.description: Page margin in points (default 72 = 1 inch). 72 points = 1 inch.

page_numbers.description: When true, draw a centered 'n / total' page number in the bottom margin of each page. Default false.
